description.zh: 把客户询盘、你提供的服务、最低预算和工期填给聊天模型。它会从六个方面说明是否值得接单。免费样例仅供评估和个人使用。
description.en: Give a chat model a client inquiry, the services you offer, your minimum budget and your timeline. It weighs six criteria and explains whether to take the job. The free sample is for evaluation and personal use only.

sourceNote.zh: 风险项 5 分最高。客户没报预算时，预算项标为「待确认」，暂不打分。作者自荐，完整提示词包另售。2026-11-21 核对了评分卡原文及许可。
sourceNote.en: A risk score of 5 means highest risk. If the client gives no budget, the budget stays unscored until confirmed. The author submitted this sample and sells the full pack separately. We checked the prompt and its terms on 2026-11-21.

readmeDescription.zh: 把客户询盘、你提供的服务、最低预算和工期填给聊天模型，得到接单建议和理由。风险项 5 分最高，客户未报预算时，预算项标为「待确认」，暂不打分。作者自荐，完整包另售。[免费样例仅供评估和个人使用]({{@oppi-digital-products.licenseUrl}})。
readmeDescription.en: Give a chat model a client inquiry, your services, minimum budget and timeline for a recommendation on whether to take the job and why. A risk score of 5 means highest risk. An unstated budget stays unscored until confirmed. The author submitted the sample and sells the full pack separately. [The free sample is for evaluation and personal use only]({{@oppi-digital-products.licenseUrl}}).
